notes.title: SuchArt - Neon Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/83e1c26f835305b3af7a9367dfd4f996fdcd4940.jpg

Hey everyone, we're happy to bring you new free update for SuchArt!

Neon paint
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/c3f505ee051f0b9e0f5bb7367715a2425cb03886.png
The year is 2130, and a new technological breakthrough has made its way into your gifted hands. Neon paint is now available from every paint dispenser and is ready to be used within and beyond reason.

Customizable Gallery lights
Is the mood of your gallery not right? Do you think a dimmer light would better suit your tastefully neon-enhanced paintings? 

Say no more: the spot lights of your gallery upper floor can now be tweaked to your liking, at any moment.

Stencils extension
This update sees the retirement of the various stencil packs that you could buy from the shop. Instead, the holostencil has been reworked and is now the king of all stencils, with:


 A ton of new stencils, including letters and numbers
 A bigger size range
 A slightly transparent material for easier positioning
 A cheaper price

Canvas colors
When requesting a new canvas, you can now choose the color you want to receive it in.

Not only a potential gain of time, this feature should also allow you to paint over the background color of your choice and then reveal it using various erasing tools, as opposed to the default white canvas. This should bring a new side use to erasing tools.

Tools labels
As an effort to improve tips and communication between players, every tool now displays their official in-game name under their inventory icon, when selected.

Fixes

 Fixed a rare white flash flickering from some meshes
 Fixed a painting issue with part of a Hangar wall
 Fixed game version display not being properly aligned in the main menu, for some resolutions
 Fixed marker color of the adjustable walls and blocks of the gallery’s B wing. This could happen after using the color wand on some elements of the A wing.


HypeTrain Summer Sale 2024

Missing the Summer Sale already? So are we, that's why HypeTrain is throwing its own: from July 15 to July 29, most of the publisher's games will be available at a nice discount. Don't miss your chance to restock your Steam library with some indie gems!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27344330/3b9a041b0b0616029b29ff2d80c6edffc5616f54.jpg

Visit HypeTrain Summer Sale 2024

notes.title: Miserable Artist DLC and Summer update
notes.notes:
Heya,

Long time no see! We haven’t been in touch for a while, but here we are back from nowhere for a fresh update!

The Miserable Artist (free) DLC

Are your clients treating you too well? Do you think you deserve less praise, and a whole lot more pettiness? Then the Miserable Artist Experience DLC is here to fix that for you. 

The Miserable Artist DLC offers you to discover a fresh take on the game’s story, and experience the life of a maybe-not-so-genius artist, after all. 

Brace yourself for awfully mean, entitled clients and start developing your personal coping strategy already. Will you ignore the pettiness, accept it, slack off and make low effort paintings, stay convinced of your well hidden deep down genius, or paint aggressive paintings in retaliation? Only you will tell.

This totally optional and free DLC should be taken as a humoristic alternative take on the game. Enable the DLC and start a new game to try it out! And if you find out it is not for you (fair enough), then it is always possible to disable it mid playthrough without losing any progress.

The Miserable Artist experience is only available in English.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478320/SuchArt__Miserable_Artist_Experience/

The Summer update (2.1.0.0)

Frame your paintings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/381d82f8d38e918e6457144d289b7070e744cbf5.png

One of your oldest requests finally made it to the game! 

The painting-framing tool is now available in your gallery and waiting for you. Choose any combination of 35 different frames and 29 materials to fit the best frame on each and any of your paintings.

With 5 different categories of frames and 4 categories of materials, we sure hope you’ll find something to your liking!

Did you say Jetpack?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/c5681ece559a3d98a4684fd3955b8b19cbcd2c0e.png

Experience the most stable, noiseless and apartment-friendly jetpack of them all.

The release of the Hangar update got you a spacious hangar and large items to paint, only to expect you to fight artificial gravity with some primitive ladders? No more!

Your new Jetpack station is waiting for you in the Hangar if you got the credits for it. No more excuses, ceiling is the limit!

More commissions variety

A good amount of commissions’ variety has been added to the portrait-less clients. More topics and style requests are waiting to be explored!

That’s it

This and also various bug fixes:


 Petbot will now wake up if burned or scared by a explosion
 Fixed a situation in which PetBot would sleep with its eyes open
 Gallery lighting improvements
 Fixed two retractable walls in the gallery that were duplicated
 Fixed two retractable wall markers were not visible
 Fixed the portable paint machine palette holder going into a wrong angle if turned while the machine was tilted
 Fixed a small unpaintable line on the small 1-2 canvas
 Better cursor speed and size across different screen resolutions
 Fixed "No reviews yet" shop entries not being localized
 Fixed bought items would never disappear from the shopping screen when bought in Creative mode
 Fixed the last radio page creadits was not shown
 Fixed duct tape would not get destroyed along paintings in incinerator, etc
 Fixed a rare bug that could break multiple things in the game


And that should be it for now. We hope you enjoy everything we’ve prepared for you today and, of course, wish you a lovely painting day!

notes.title: Full Release & Biggest Update on Oct 13!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/3576b3ce67065fbc1144c13c731b8ab114672c6c.jpg

Hi everyone!

SuchArt has been in Early Access for a year and a few months, and this period has been indeed fruitful: the game has 97% positive reviews, over 200k wishlists, and almost 800k players taking Creative Space into account – a great amount of work has been put into SuchArt, and we see that you guys appreciate it.

As much as we’d like to keep the intrigue, the title already gave it away – yes, the big moment has arrived, and SuchArt finally leaves Early Access on October 13, 10 AM PT. Moreover, it also gets its biggest update to yet!

The full release update will introduce a whole bunch of new content: reworked studio and gallery, a new Hangar area with its own game mechanics, new tools, items, commissions, and much, much more. We’ll tell you everything about the new stuff upon the release – it’s super exciting, take our word for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/a35180f9ab63bf751975da7f444ccc21fe2b9ae2.jpg

To celebrate an event of such magnitude, everyone will be able to grab the game with a 20% launch discount. Besides, SuchArt can be purchased as a part of our bundle with House flipper with an additional 15% off.

We hope you’re as excited about the upcoming full release as we are! If you’ve been following and (hopefully) enjoying SuchArt for a while now, you can help us spread the word about the game and share it with your friends or, say, your favourite influencer – this would be the greatest help possible!


Set a reminder for October 13, make sure you’ve got enough space on your computer, and get ready to conquer new artistic horizons – your most fascinating creative journey is yet ahead!

notes.title: Ver. 1.5.0.0 - Graphics Tablet Update
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Again, long time no see, but this pause has been justified — we’re coming back with a very handy feature many of you have been looking forward to. Well, okay, there’s probably no point in keeping it a mystery since it’s all in the title, so let’s just make it 100% clear: SuchArt now officially supports graphics tablets, yay!

A few words about tablet support

So, we’ve added tablet support with two different possible behaviours: “Basic” or “Advanced”, to choose according to your preferences. Using a tablet allows for more precise control of your brushes, and supports pressure for most of the tools!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/e7f9aeaa8163f9bca24369e7a435e46b54b33ff4.png

Other changes


 The different MyManager modes (to receive more or less commissions) can now last much longer
 Looking up or down doesn’t slow down your movement anymore

Fixes


 You cannot get your PetBot stuck in the trash compactor anymore!
 Fixed/Improved using some precise brushes could leave a stroke of paint instead of a dot on some specific angles
 Fixed picking paint from palette on a portable paint dispenser was a bit buggy 
 Fixed some rare potential crashes
 Minor changes to the keyboard/controller choice popup. This might prevent some issues for some players.


And that’s it for today! Make sure to try using your tablet in SuchArt and share your results and feedback with us. Also, don’t forget about the contest we’re running together with our friends from LEAP Games — that actually might be the perfect occasion to get your tablet out.


Finally, there's a HypeTrain Digital Publisher Sale going on until Nov 8, during which you can grab SuchArt and many other awesome titles with great discounts — go check it out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/3457d65a1accb112ea07d9b859bd79cead005822.gif

And now that’s definitely it, I swear. Have a beautiful day, and may the inspiration be with you!

notes.title: Ver. 1.4.0 - Texture Brushes Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/8a73c495810c7d84322c30115c885a5a8eb7f94f.gif

Hi there!

We haven’t posted anything in a while (but that’s because we’ve been super busy working on the game, I swear), so now’s the perfect time to elegantly come back with great news: the first major update since the release is out!

Let’s quickly (or not so tbh) go through everything awaiting you in this update!

4 new tools for additional texturing effects:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/fc6bff8dbc570926137e47d5d1b80f1f4d874449.png

 A foam brush 
 A feathered brush 
 A scattered brush 
 A new kind of painting knife


3 new precise brushes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/acd035f7d55611973b1a463b9385f491d0e410a0.png

 A super-thin brush 
 A thin flat brush
 A fine blender


A fancy flying tool shelf!

A new commission… and a new unique reward?

It is said that Koki is out there looking for you again. What could he possibly have to offer this time?

Mop and sponge rework

The sponge and mop have been reworked. Wet, they will clean. Dry, they will paint. And don’t forget to randomly squeeze the sponge, because it feels good.

Other tools reworks and additions


 Reworked roll brush and fan brush paint textures. The fan brush is now more suitable as a texturing tool.
 More brushes rotations. Many tools have been added extra rotations, especially at 45°
 Added a new, smaller, tape width to the tape tool.
 The standard (pointy) brushes now have cleaner strokes


Other changes you shouldn’t miss


 Paint now takes twice as much time to dry naturally
 You can now directly attach the tool you have in hand to a tool holder by activating it
 You can now deselect a tool you have in hand by pressing its assigned key again
 Brazier will now do proper fire damage. Get those spray cans ready.


Changes you don’t care much about


 When a brush collides with something, the minimum required speed to leave a splash of paint is now a little bit higher 
 Updated the shop icon of a brush
 Added a visual indicator when holding a stencil in the wrong direction


Boring fixes


 Fixed a rare bug that could erase painted surfaces on load
 Fixed some achievements progress could get reset
 Fixed an issue causing the end game achievement to sometimes not trigger
 Fixed could pick paint (from blobs) from the other side of a paint palette
 Fixed one of the tree sculpture’s rocks
 Fixed an uncommon, minor and difficult to explain issue happening when rotating objects
 Fixed virtual windows landscapes FOV not matching with the camera zoom
 Fixed an email from Asha was not delayed as it should have been
 Fixed some basic tutorial messages would not show up if playing in Creative mode
 Fixed the color shifter tool would make a transparent surface black instead of preserving its alpha value
 Selling machine: fixed could pick an item while on its way to be sold
 Now preventing to attach stencils again to a canvas after it starts moving to get sold
 Adjusted some tools snapping position and rotation (when attached to a tool holder)
 Preventing to hang stuff on the bobbleheads’ chest, since it sometimes can’t be removed afterwards (and has little use anyway)


Phew, that should be it. Now you should first officially understand and forgive us for the long silence, and then plunge into the game and check out all the new stuff. Like, you really should, jokes aside (kk, let’s leave jokes in their places, but still).

Finally, if you still don’t own SuchArt for some reason, make sure to grab it with an 20% discount until Sep 4!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

Have a lovely day, and stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.8.0 - Added save backups
notes.notes:
Hey,

Here is a small update, but which may go a long way if you're unlucky enough to ever run into some game breaking issue:


Added a basic backup system for the save files. Every time the game saves, a backup of your previous save is now created (Note; your paintings are NOT part of the backup, but those are unlikely to ever get corrupted). The main point is to avoid loosing all your progress if for any reason your save.dat file gets corrupted someday. After saving once in game, your first backup and a readme file will be created next to your save files. Hopefully you probably won't ever need to read it.
Added a button to reset your character position, down in the options, if you ever get stuck somewhere.
